site.name: ImageForge
site.description: Convert images between PNG, JPG, and WebP in your browser. Fast, free, and private.

home.heroTitle: Convert images instantly. Fast, free, and private.
home.heroSubtitle: Convert between PNG, JPG, and WebP right in your browser. No upload, no account, no waiting.
home.benefitPrivateBody: PNG, JPG, and WebP conversions run entirely in your browser. Your files are never uploaded.
home.benefitFastBody: Conversions happen locally with no network round-trip, off the main thread so the page stays responsive.
home.benefitDevBody: A versioned REST API and conversion engine power the same conversions you see here.
home.footer: Browser-side conversion for PNG, JPG, and WebP. AVIF and a server-side path for large and batch jobs are in progress.

converter.dropHint: PNG, JPG, or WebP · processed locally
converter.errUnsupportedFile: Unsupported file. Use a PNG, JPG, or WebP image.
converter.errUnreadable: That image could not be read by your browser.
converter.errPickDifferent: Pick a target format different from the source.
converter.unavailable: Your browser does not support local image conversion (OffscreenCanvas / Web Workers). A server-side path is planned as a fallback.

convertPage.processedLocally: Converted locally in your browser — no upload.
